name: Guidance term by frequency band and region mask (megapack)
plain: Both nodes reshape the guidance term G = x̂ − x̂_c, the push past the conditional prediction left by the mix rule and weak branch. WhereBands splits G into a low band (Gaussian blur, or an FFT radius below a cutoff) and the high remainder, and scales each; with plain CFG each band then has scale 1 + m(w − 1), the frequency-decoupled idea in its simplest form. WhereRegion multiplies G by a feathered mask map with separate inside and outside factors, so 0 outside means only the conditional prediction there. Factors of 1 everywhere leave the result bit-identical.
math:
G = x̂ − x̂_c.
Bands: L = blur_σ(G) (gaussian) or IFFT(FFT(G)·[r ≤ cutoff]), r the frequency radius in Nyquist units (fft); H = G − L; G′ = m_low·L + m_high·H.
Region: M = clamp(blur_f(resize_bilinear(mask)), 0, 1), M ← 1 − M if invert; G″ = G′·(o + (i − o)·M).
x̂ = x̂_c + G″.

props.params: WhereBands: method=gaussian, low_multiplier=1, high_multiplier=1, blur_sigma=2 (latent px), fft_cutoff=0.25. WhereRegion: mask, inside_multiplier=1, outside_multiplier=0, feather=1, invert=false
